section_summary.extract_value: This section reports convergent and discriminant validity evidence for two measurement scales: CEMS and IES-2. The CEMS showed lack of convergent validity for the PEM factor in the female sample (VEM=0.48, at the limit of significance), while IES-2 demonstrated adequate convergent validity across all samples. Both scales showed good discriminant validity indicators across all samples based on r² values.
